nativeUi.runtime: Electron on X11 with an isolated test profile
nativeUi.agents: Fake local coding agents; no paid provider requests
checks: Two Manager teams run concurrently in separate background chats
Lead assigns tasks to selected worker agents
Concurrency limit and one active task per selected agent are enforced within a team
Dependent workers receive predecessor summaries and changed paths
Each background coding team integrates into its own conversation working copy
Original project files remain unchanged before explicit review and merge
Background chat titles use the user task
A chatting agent uses the generated Electron-as-Node command to create two worker chats
Worker cards appear in the parent reply and link to worker chats
Worker chats link back to their parent
Workers continue after the parent finishes and report Ready to review
Team slash command opens setup with the task filled in

boundaries: Tributary must remain open while teams run
Background coding copies require a committed Git repository
No remote execution on teammates' computers
Real provider end-to-end delegation and packaged cross-platform execution were not tested
Chat delegation uses a scoped shell command; direct text connections cannot use it
Two active worker chats per parent and four new workers per turn
